title: At Most k Trades
statement:
You know the price of a stock on each of `n` days. You may complete at most `k` trades. A trade means buying one share on some day and selling it on a later day. You can hold at most one share at a time, so a new trade can only start after the previous one has been sold. Find the largest total profit (it is `0` if you make no trades).

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains the `n` prices.

## Output
Print the largest total profit.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 15000`
- `1 <= k <= 20`
- `0 <= price <= 10^6`
